methodological_rigor.justification: Case series with limited methodological structure. Descriptive analysis only; no comparative groups or control. Case selection criteria may not be explicit.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Case series evidence—lowest rung of evidence hierarchy. Clinical value primarily educational and hypothesis-generating rather than practice-changing.

reporting_quality.justification: Case reports may lack standardized reporting format. No formal data archiving or reproducibility assessment.

novelty_literature.justification: Contribution limited to clinical illustration; unlikely to represent novel mechanism or intervention.

writing_presentation.justification: Case narratives typically clear but limited in scope and impact.

chief_reviewer.rationale: Tier 4/Reject: Case series lacks rigor for primary research publication. Better suited to case report format or clinical vignette sections.
